import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { RouterOutlet, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive } from '@angular/router'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { AuthService } from '../../services/auth.service'; import { User } from '../../models/api.models'; @Component({ selector: 'app-layout', standalone: true, imports: [RouterOutlet, RouterLink, RouterLinkActive, CommonModule], template: `
WorkTracker
Dashboard Sessions Reports Settings
Admin
Overview Users Reports Activity Analytics
{{ initials }}
{{ user.fullName }}
{{ user.email }}
`, }) export class LayoutComponent implements OnInit { user: User | null = null; constructor(private auth: AuthService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.auth.user$.subscribe(u => this.user = u); } get initials(): string { return (this.user?.fullName ?? '') .split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(); } logout(): void { this.auth.logout(); } }
